interpretation.low: This score suggests low work-related burnout risk right now. You're showing steady balance — keep up what's working for you.
interpretation.moderate: This score suggests a moderate level of work-related burnout risk. It's not a diagnosis, but it may be a good time to build in regular breaks and a bit more self-care.
interpretation.high: This score suggests elevated work-related burnout risk. It is not a diagnosis, but it may indicate that current work demands are placing significant strain on your recovery, energy, and wellbeing. You may consider reaching out to HR or a mental health professional if this feels difficult to manage alone.
